cohort: 290 pregnant women diagnosed with preeclampsia with severe features and delivered at Chonburi Hospital between January 2017 and June 2020
finding: There was no significant difference in the rate of low Apgar score at 5 minutes between women with new onset hypertension and those with chronic hypertension, but the incidence of impaired liver function and HELLP syndrome were increased in the new onset hypertension group.
